comment: The rule a trigger or ability choice shows (EngineDisplayText.abilityRule on iOS, Android and web): XMage's picker labels are "N. " plus the ability's rule, which some abilities give without their trigger or not at all, so the full line comes from the source card's rules. A fragment found in exactly one line shows that line; an empty label shows the card's only triggered line; otherwise the label without its number, capitalized; nothing when there is nothing.

cases.name: {this} in the label is the source's name, so it finds the card's line
cases.label: 1. When {this} enters, create two 0/1 green Dinosaur Egg creature tokens.
rules: When Palani's Hatcher enters, create two 0/1 green Dinosaur Egg creature tokens.
Other Dinosaurs you control have haste.
cases.expect: When Palani's Hatcher enters, create two 0/1 green Dinosaur Egg creature tokens.

cases.name: {this} with no line to find: the label, named
cases.label: 1. When {this} enters, search your library for a basic land card.
cases.expect: When Topiary Stomper enters, search your library for a basic land card.

cases.name: effect-only label: the one line that holds it
cases.label: 2. it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.
rules: Whenever a Dinosaur you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.
cases.expect: Whenever a Dinosaur you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.

cases.name: empty label: the card's only triggered line
rules: Whenever a Dinosaur you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.
cases.expect: Whenever a Dinosaur you control is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any target that isn't a Dinosaur.

cases.name: an ability word before the trigger counts
rules: Enrage — Whenever Ripjaw Raptor is dealt damage, draw a card.
cases.expect: Enrage — Whenever Ripjaw Raptor is dealt damage, draw a card.

cases.name: a fragment in two lines stays the fragment
cases.label: 1. it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
rules: When Apex Altisaur enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
Enrage — Whenever Apex Altisaur is dealt damage, it fights up to one target creature you don't control.
cases.expect: It fights up to one target creature you don't control.

cases.name: a full label keeps its line
cases.label: 3. Whenever Edgar Markov attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
rules: Eminence — Whenever you cast another Vampire spell, if Edgar Markov is in the command zone or on the battlefield, create a 1/1 black Vampire creature token.
Whenever Edgar Markov attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
cases.expect: Whenever Edgar Markov attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.

cases.name: no source rules: the label without its number
cases.label: 1. {T}: Add {G}.

cases.name: empty label, two triggered lines: nothing to show
rules: When this enters, draw a card.
